hook:
Still naturally aspirated.

Ford kept the atmospheric V8 and the manual gearbox almost every rival has dropped.
body:
The most powerful naturally aspirated Mustang Ford has put on sale, with a Tremec six-speed and forged connecting rods borrowed from the GT500.

2025 Ford Mustang Dark Horse — 500 hp · 418 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 4.1 sec.

· 500 hp at 7,250 rpm, naturally aspirated — the most powerful non-supercharged Mustang sold.
· A Tremec six-speed manual, in a market that has quietly stopped offering them.
· Forged connecting rods carried over from the GT500, because 7,250 rpm asks for them.
· 4.1 seconds to 60 mph and 166 mph, with nothing between your right foot and the intake.

It is among the last naturally aspirated V8s offered with a manual gearbox.
cta: Turbocharged and quicker, or naturally aspirated and this?
